efficacy_toxicity_weight.description: 0 = minimize toxicity at all costs; 1 = maximize efficacy at all costs.

toxicity_vetoes.description: Toxicities the user wants to avoid (e.g. 'severe neuropathy', 'cardiotoxicity', 'IV chair time').

modality_constraints.description: Modality limits (e.g. 'oral preferred', 'no transplant', 'no inpatient infusion').

free_text_constraints.description: Anything else; free text, never identifying.

prefers_trials.description: Whether to surface clinical trials prominently.
